Name: NPC_PARAM_ST
Description:
Defines the stats for a given enemy or group of enemies. Does not determine model or location.
Stats are often affected greatly by attached SpEffects.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Picks the character's BehaviorParam rows: row ID = (200000 + this value) × 1000 + behaviour judge ID. Values above 99999 disable the lookup.

Fields.Name: Resist Correction - Poison
Fields.Description: ResistCorrectParam row used after each Poison proc to change the resistance, by the number of procs so far. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: NPC name text ID. Read when the character's name is displayed or sent to other players; -1: no name.

Fields.Name: Turn Velocity
Fields.Description: Turning speed in degrees per second, set on the character's turn controller when it spawns.

Fields.Name: Capsule Height
Fields.Description: Height of the character's collision capsule (metres), set up by the physics when the character spawns.

Fields.Name: Capsule Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of the character's collision capsule (metres), set up by the physics when the character spawns.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight (mass) passed to the character's physics when it spawns.

Fields.Name: Display Position - Height Offset
Fields.Description: Raises or lowers the model display position (metres) relative to the collision. 0: no offset.

Fields.Name: Base HP
Fields.Description: Maximum HP when the character spawns.

Fields.Name: Base FP
Fields.Description: Maximum FP when the character spawns; current FP is clamped to it.

Fields.Name: Base Runes
Fields.Description: The amount of soul that a character can get at the time of death.

Fields.Name: Enemy Itemlot ID
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_enemy row rolled when the character dies. Takes priority over the map lot. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Map Itemlot ID
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row rolled when the character dies. Used only when Enemy Itemlot ID is -1. -1: none.

Fields.Name: FootIK Ankle Roll Angle Limit
Fields.Description: Foot IK: maximum ankle roll angle (degrees). -1: no limit.

Fields.Name: Character Hit Group
Fields.Description: Collision group against other characters.

Fields.Name: Face Icon ID
Fields.Description: Face picture shown for this NPC in the multiplayer menus. 0: none, the model is shown instead.

Fields.Name: Deactivation Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (metres) at which the character is deactivated. -1: default.

Fields.Name: Proximity Check Radius Override
Fields.Description: When 0 or more, replaces the radius (m) that event-script proximity checks use for this character: the character counts as near a checked point within this distance. −1: the check's own radius. Retail 45 and 30 on two night bosses' random-encounter rows.

Fields.Name: Foot IK Appearance Height Limit
Fields.Description: Foot IK: maximum up/down correction of the model's display height (metres).

Fields.Name: Humanity Lot ID
Fields.Description: Specify the lottery ID of human nature to be acquired at the time of death

Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect slot 0, applied while the character lives. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [1]
Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect slot 1, applied while the character lives. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [2]
Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect slot 2, applied while the character lives. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID [7]
Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect slot 7, applied while the character lives. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reward Item Lot (Shifting Earth)
Fields.Description: Reward item lot (with the Dormant Power roll) used instead of Reward Item Lot when the character is flagged as part of a Shifting Earth (Cataclysm) map. -1: always use Reward Item Lot. Retail: the "(Cataclysm)" lots of field bosses (56 rows).

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption % - Physical
Fields.Description: Physical damage blocked when this character guards (percent). The slash/strike/thrust guard modifiers below scale it: blocked = value × (1 + modifier/100), then × SpEffect guard bonuses.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption % - Magic
Fields.Description: Magic damage blocked when this character guards (percent).

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption % - Fire
Fields.Description: Fire damage blocked when this character guards (percent).

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption % - Lightning
Fields.Description: Lightning damage blocked when this character guards (percent).

Fields.Name: Poise Recovery Delay Modifier
Fields.Description: Sets how long poise waits after a hit before it starts to recover: (1 + value) × 5 seconds.

Fields.Name: Poise Break Knockback Distance
Fields.Description: Knockback distance used when this character's poise breaks. 0 or less: the default distance.

Fields.Name: Stamina
Fields.Description: Maximum stamina when the character spawns.

Fields.Name: Stamina Recovery
Fields.Description: Stamina recovered per second, plus SpEffect bonuses.

Fields.Name: Defence - Physical
Fields.Description: Physical defence. Each physical type uses it × (100 + that type's modifier)/100, then the SpEffect defence rates and bonuses apply.

Fields.Name: Defence Modifier % - Slash
Fields.Description: Percentage added to physical defence against slash attacks (negative lowers it).

Fields.Name: Defence Modifier % - Strike
Fields.Description: Percentage added to physical defence against strike attacks (negative lowers it).

Fields.Name: Defence Modifier % - Thrust
Fields.Description: Percentage added to physical defence against thrust attacks (negative lowers it).

Fields.Name: Defence - Magic
Fields.Description: Magic defence, × the SpEffect defence rate plus bonuses.

Fields.Name: Defence - Fire
Fields.Description: Fire defence, × the SpEffect defence rate plus bonuses.

Fields.Name: Defence - Lightning
Fields.Description: Lightning defence, × the SpEffect defence rate plus bonuses.

Fields.Name: Weapon Repel Power
Fields.Description: Repel power: compared with the attacker's repel values to decide whether attacks bounce off this character.

Fields.Name: Resist - Poison
Fields.Description: Poison resistance: the buildup needed for a proc, × the SpEffect resist rate.

Fields.Name: Resist - Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Scarlet Rot resistance: the buildup needed for a proc, × the SpEffect resist rate.

Fields.Name: Resist - Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Blood Loss resistance: the buildup needed for a proc, × the SpEffect resist rate.

Fields.Name: Resist - Death Blight
Fields.Description: Death Blight resistance: the buildup needed for a proc, × the SpEffect resist rate.

Fields.Name: Ghost Model ID
Fields.Description: Replacement model ID used when Is Wandering Ghost turns the character into a wandering ghost. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Override Resource Chr ID
Fields.Description: Replacement resource character ID, set when the character spawns. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Guard Angle
Fields.Description: Guard angle of the character (degrees), read through the character's guard getter.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Modifier % - Slash
Fields.Description: Percentage added to the physical guard absorption when blocking slash attacks.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Modifier % - Strike
Fields.Description: Percentage added to the physical guard absorption when blocking strike attacks.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Modifier % - Thrust
Fields.Description: Percentage added to the physical guard absorption when blocking thrust attacks.

Fields.Name: Lock Gaze Point - Dummy Poly ID [6]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the camera looks at for lock-on point 6 (lock-on dummy poly 226). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Override Texture Chr ID
Fields.Description: Replacement texture character ID, set when the character spawns. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Drop Type
Fields.Description: How the death drop is shown: 0 from the corpse, 1 as a visible item. Read with the item search radius when the drop is created.

Fields.Name: Received Knockback %
Fields.Description: Knockback rate (percent) read by the character's knockback handling as value/100.

Fields.Name: Knockback Param ID
Fields.Description: KnockBackParam row used for this character's knockback.

Fields.Name: Fall Damage Reduction %
Fields.Description: Fall damage reduction: fall damage × (100 − value)/100. 100: no fall damage.

Fields.Name: Guard Boost
Fields.Description: Guard boost of this character: reduces the stamina it loses when it blocks attacks.

Fields.Name: Resist - Sleep
Fields.Description: Sleep resistance: the buildup needed for a proc, × the SpEffect resist rate.

Fields.Name: Resist - Madness
Fields.Description: Madness resistance: the buildup needed for a proc, × the SpEffect resist rate.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist - Sleep
Fields.Description: Percentage of incoming Sleep buildup this character blocks when it guards an attack.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist - Madness
Fields.Description: Percentage of incoming Madness buildup this character blocks when it guards an attack.

Fields.Name: Lock Gaze Point - Dummy Poly ID [7]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the camera looks at for lock-on point 7 (lock-on dummy poly 227). -1: none.

Fields.Name: FP Recovery
Fields.Description: MP recovery basic speed [% / s]

Fields.Name: Weapon Repel Absorption
Fields.Description: Damage reduction (percent) when this character repels an attack: damage × (1 − value/100).

Fields.Name: Default LOD Param ID
Fields.Description: Default LOD setting of the character. 0 or less: use the game's default.

Fields.Name: Draw Type
Fields.Description: Drawing type, read when the character's model is set up.

Fields.Name: NPC Type
Fields.Description: NPC type. OK if Zako enemies / boss enemies are distinguished

Fields.Name: Team Type
Fields.Description: Team of the character: decides who it can hit and target. Default 6 when there is no row.

Fields.Name: Move Type
Fields.Description: Movement method; changes how the character is controlled and moves.

Fields.Name: Lock Distance
Fields.Description: Lock-on distance (metres) used when the player locks on to this character.

Fields.Name: Weak Point - SE Material
Fields.Description: Hit sound material of the weak point (slot 1). Default 139 when there is no row.

Fields.Name: Weak Point - SFX Material
Fields.Description: Hit effect material of the weak point (slot 1). Default 139 when there is no row.

Fields.Name: Parts Damage - Attack Type
Fields.Description: Which attacks use the part damage rates: 0 only attacks that allow part damage (e.g. arrows for headshots), 1 all attacks. Without either, the part damage rate is ignored.

Fields.Name: Vow Type
Fields.Description: Covenant type of the character, mapped to the covenant used by the game.

Fields.Name: Guard Level
Fields.Description: Guard level: decides which guard reaction plays when this character blocks.

Fields.Name: Burn SFX Type
Fields.Description: Burning effect type: 0 normal, 1 corpse.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist - Poison
Fields.Description: Percentage of incoming Poison buildup this character blocks when it guards an attack.

Fields.Name: Parry Defence Power
Fields.Description: Parry resistance used when this character is parried.

Fields.Name: SFX Size
Fields.Description: Size class used to pick hit and status effects: 0 normal, 1 large, 2 medium.

Fields.Name: Push Out Camera Region Radius
Fields.Description: Radius (metres) of the region that pushes the camera away from this character.

Fields.Name: Hit Stop Type
Fields.Description: Hit-stop handling when this character is hit: 0, 1 or 2 pick different hit-stop setups.

Fields.Name: Ladder End Check Offset Top

Fields.Name: Ladder End Check Offset Bottom

Fields.Description: If you want to prevent the cross rigid from hitting you

Fields.Name: Is Ghost
Fields.Description: Marks the character as a ghost.

Fields.Name: Is No Damage Motion
Fields.Description: The character plays no damage animation when it takes 0 damage.

Fields.Name: Is Undulating
Fields.Description: Tilts the character forward and back to follow the slope of the ground (with the undulation limits and gain).

Fields.Name: Is Wandering Ghost
Fields.Description: Makes the character a wandering ghost (phantom type) and uses Ghost Model ID as its model. Wandering Ghost Phantom ID ≥ 0 has the same effect.

Fields.Description: LockCamParam row used when the player locks on to this character. A lock camera set on the character at runtime takes priority. Its lock keep time also replaces the default one while this character is the target. -1: none.

Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect slot 31, applied while the character lives. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Disable Lock-on Angle
Fields.Description: Angle (degrees) of a cone below the character in which it cannot be locked on to. 0: none.

Fields.Name: LOD Level to Disable Cloth Processing
Fields.Description: LOD level from which cloth simulation is turned off. -1: never.

Fields.Name: Use Foot IK for Undulating Character
Fields.Description: Uses the foot IK result to follow the slope of the ground.

Fields.Name: Attach to Ground upon Death
Fields.Description: Grounds the collision capsule when the character is placed as a corpse.

Fields.Name: Exclude Group Reward Check
Fields.Description: The character is ignored when the game checks whether a whole group has been killed for a group reward.

Fields.Name: Enable AI Lock Dummy Poly [212]
Fields.Description: Enemies may aim at lock dummy poly 212 on this character. Default on.

Fields.Name: Enable AI Lock Dummy Poly [213]
Fields.Description: Enemies may aim at lock dummy poly 213 on this character. Default on.

Fields.Name: Enable AI Lock Dummy Poly [214]
Fields.Description: Enemies may aim at lock dummy poly 214 on this character. Default on.

Fields.Name: Disable Open Activation - XB1
Fields.Description: Clears the character's activation in open-field maps (map areas 50–88).

Fields.Name: Disable Legacy Activation - XB1
Fields.Description: Clears the character's activation in maps outside the open-field range.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery Param ID
Fields.Description: Flask refill setting (HPEstusFlaskRecoveryParam row) checked when the character dies; the refill chances below are rolled only when this is 0 or more. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Role Name ID
Fields.Description: Role name text shown when this character is summoned. -1: the phantom's default role name; 0: no role name.

Fields.Name: HP/FP Flask Recovery Chance
Fields.Description: HP / MP est recovery probability when defeating an enemy. The numerator is obtained from the NPC para with 10000 as the denominator.

Fields.Name: HP Flask Recovery Chance
Fields.Description: Recovery probability of MP Est when defeating an enemy. The numerator is obtained from the NPC para with 10000 as the denominator.

Fields.Name: FP Flask Recovery Chance
Fields.Description: Recovery probability of MP Est when defeating an enemy. The numerator is obtained from the NPC para with 10000 as the denominator.

Fields.Name: Missed HP/FP Flask Recovery - Bonus Chance
Fields.Description: Added to the shared flask refill chance after each miss (out of 10000), until a refill succeeds.

Fields.Name: Missed HP Flask Recovery - Bonus Chance
Fields.Description: The next probability increase value when you miss the HP Est Recovery Lottery. Addition value of numerator.

Fields.Name: Missed FP Flask Recovery - Bonus Chance
Fields.Description: The next probability increase value when the MP est recovery lottery is missed. Addition value of numerator.

Fields.Name: Wandering Ghost Phantom ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row for the wandering-ghost look. 0 or more also makes the character a wandering ghost (phantom type) when it spawns. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Listen Head Size
Fields.Description: Head size used for hearing checks instead of the capsule. Below 0: use the capsule.

Fields.Name: Sound Bank ID
Fields.Description: Sound bank to load for the character. -1: the bank of its own character ID.

Fields.Name: Forward Undulation Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum forward/back tilt (degrees) when following the slope of the ground.

Fields.Name: Side Undulation Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum sideways tilt (degrees) when following the slope of the ground.

Fields.Name: Platoon - Deactivation Movement Speed
Fields.Description: Movement speed (metres per second) of the character while it is deactivated but still moving as part of a group.

Fields.Name: Platoon - Deactivation Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (metres) at which the character switches to deactivated movement.

Fields.Name: Sound Source Validity - Player Distance
Fields.Description: The character's sounds play only within this distance of the player (metres). -1: any distance.

Fields.Name: Undulation Angle Correction
Fields.Description: Speed at which the character's tilt follows the slope of the ground.

Fields.Name: Automatic Foot Effect - Decal Base ID [2]
Fields.Description: Footstep decal base ID 2 used by the automatic foot effects. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Automatic Foot Effect - Decal Base ID [3]
Fields.Description: Footstep decal base ID 3 used by the automatic foot effects. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Motion Re-target Reference Chr ID
Fields.Description: Character ID whose animations are retargeted onto this character, set when it spawns. -1: none.

Fields.Name: SFX Resource Bank ID
Fields.Description: Effect resource bank to load for the character. -1: the bank of its own character ID.

Fields.Name: Activation Update Priority
Fields.Description: Activation and update priority: larger values lower the character's update level sooner. Default 1.8 when there is no row.

Fields.Name: Chr Navmesh Flag - Alive
Fields.Description: Navmesh flag the character sets on the navmesh it stands on while alive.

Fields.Name: Chr Navmesh Flag - Dead
Fields.Description: Navmesh flag the character sets on the navmesh it lies on when dead.

Fields.Name: Affected By Necromancy
Fields.Description: Set: when killed, the character can rise as a ghost for Revenant's Necromancy (chance from PlayerCommonParam Necromancy Chance). Clear: never rises. Retail: set on 1,994 of 3,016 rows.

Fields.Name: Count As Nearby Enemy
Fields.Description: Set: while alive and hostile, the character is gathered by an engine check for enemies within Lock-On Distance + 15 m of a point (the use of the gathered list is not established). Clear on interactable objects, invaders and lightning balls.

Fields.Name: Use Special Kill SpEffect
Fields.Description: Set: when this character is killed, the killer's on-kill effects apply their special kill SpEffect (SpEffectParam applyIdOnKillSp) instead of their usual one (applyIdOnGetSoul); a special ID of -1 falls back to the usual one. Retail: set on 8 rows.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Wheel Rotation Type
Fields.Description: Wheel rotation type for characters with wheels (0 none).

Fields.Name: Wheel Rotation Radius
Fields.Description: Wheel radius (metres) used to turn the wheels from the movement.

Fields.Name: Retarget Movement Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on root motion when animations are retargeted from another character.

Fields.Name: Ladder - Warp Z Offset
Fields.Description: Offsets along the Damipoly Z-axis at the specified value. Both positive and negative numbers can be specified.

Fields.Name: Load Asset ID
Fields.Description: Asset loaded together with the character, set when it spawns. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Overlap Camera - Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Set the Damipoly ID (220-227) to enable the overlap camera. If it is -1, it will be invalid.

Fields.Name: Material Ex Param ID [0]
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row applied to the character's materials while it lives (slot 0). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Material Ex Param ID [1]
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row applied to the character's materials while it lives (slot 1). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Material Ex Param ID [2]
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row applied to the character's materials while it lives (slot 2). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Material Ex Param ID [3]
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row applied to the character's materials while it lives (slot 3). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Material Ex Param ID [4]
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row applied to the character's materials while it lives (slot 4). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Sleep Collector - Enemy Item Lot
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_enemy row rolled when the character is collected while asleep. Takes priority over the map lot. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Sleep Collector - Map Item Lot
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row rolled when the character is collected while asleep. Used only when the enemy lot is -1. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Foot IK - Error On Gain
Fields.Description: Foot IK: gain of the display height correction while it is being applied.

Fields.Name: Foot IK - Error Off Gain
Fields.Description: Foot IK: gain of the display height correction while it is released.

Fields.Name: Sound Add Bank ID
Fields.Description: Extra sound bank loaded for the character. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Material Variation Value
Fields.Description: Variation value combined with the hit materials to pick status, damage effect and sound variants.

Fields.Name: Weak Point - Material Variation Value
Fields.Description: Variation value combined with the weak-point hit materials to pick status, damage effect and sound variants.

Fields.Name: Poise
Fields.Description: Maximum poise (SpEffect bonuses are added on top).

Fields.Name: Poise Recovery Rate
Fields.Description: Poise recovery after the recovery delay: about value × 45 points per second, × SpEffect modifiers.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption % - Poise Damage
Fields.Description: Poise damage blocked (percent) when this character guards the hit.

Fields.Name: Resist Correction - Blood Loss
Fields.Description: ResistCorrectParam row used after each Blood Loss proc to change the resistance, by the number of procs so far. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resist Correction - Death Blight
Fields.Description: ResistCorrectParam row used after each Death Blight proc to change the resistance, by the number of procs so far. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resist Correction - Frostbite
Fields.Description: ResistCorrectParam row used after each Frostbite proc to change the resistance, by the number of procs so far. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resist Correction - Sleep
Fields.Description: ResistCorrectParam row used after each Sleep proc to change the resistance, by the number of procs so far. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resist Correction - Madness
Fields.Description: ResistCorrectParam row used after each Madness proc to change the resistance, by the number of procs so far. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Chr Dead Tutorial Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag set when the character dies, for a tutorial. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Step Display Interpolation Time
Fields.Description: Duration (seconds) of the step display smoothing. Default 0.5.

Fields.Name: Step Display Interpolation Trigger Value
Fields.Description: Height change that triggers the step display smoothing. Default 0.6.

Fields.Name: Lock Score Offset
Fields.Description: Added to this character's lock-on score when the game picks a lock-on target. Positive values make it preferred.

Fields.Name: Reward Item Lot
Fields.Description: Item lot rolled as the character's defeat reward (includes the Dormant Power roll), unless the spawn sets its own lot, the character is mutated (Chaos Matching: Reward ItemLot ID) or Shifting Earth applies (Reward Item Lot (Shifting Earth)). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Day 2 Scaling SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect for the character's Day 2 scaling. Retail: the "[Day 2 Scaling]" effects 7400-7467 (7410 on 864 rows), 0 on blank rows.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Magic
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that deal magic damage to this character. Of the bonus rates that apply to a hit, the highest is used (times Poise Bonus %: Weak Part); the extra poise damage is poise x (rate - 1), capped by Max Poise Bonus. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Fire
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that deal fire damage to this character. Of the bonus rates that apply to a hit, the highest is used (times Poise Bonus %: Weak Part); the extra poise damage is poise x (rate - 1), capped by Max Poise Bonus. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that deal lightning damage to this character. The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. Quirk: it is only taken when Poise Bonus %: Magic is higher than the rates already applied to the hit (always true for a hit with no other damage type while Magic is above 0). 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Holy
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that deal holy damage to this character. Of the bonus rates that apply to a hit, the highest is used (times Poise Bonus %: Weak Part); the extra poise damage is poise x (rate - 1), capped by Max Poise Bonus. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Poison
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that carry a poison effect (the attack's or the attacker's poison SpEffects). The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that carry a scarlet rot effect (the attack's or the attacker's scarlet rot SpEffects). The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that carry a blood loss effect (the attack's or the attacker's blood loss SpEffects). The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Death Blight
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that carry a death blight effect (the attack's or the attacker's death blight SpEffects). The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that carry a frostbite effect (the attack's or the attacker's frostbite SpEffects). The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Sleep
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that carry a sleep effect (the attack's or the attacker's sleep SpEffects). The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Madness
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that carry a madness effect (the attack's or the attacker's madness SpEffects). The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Weak A
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier used when this character has Weakness Type A set and the hit's Weak A damage rate is above 1. The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Weak B
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier used when this character has Weakness Type B set and the hit's Weak B damage rate is above 1. The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Weak C
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier used when this character has Weakness Type C set and the hit's Weak C damage rate is above 1. The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Weak D
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier used when this character has Weakness Type D set and the hit's Weak D damage rate is above 1. The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Weak E
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier used when this character has Weakness Type E set and the hit's Weak E damage rate is above 1. The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Weak F
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier used when this character has Weakness Type F set and the hit's Weak F damage rate is above 1. The highest applicable bonus rate is used; see Poise Bonus %: Magic. 1: no bonus.

Fields.Name: Poise Bonus %: Weak Part
Fields.Description: Poise damage multiplier for hits that land on the character's weak part (the hitbox that uses Damage % Weak Part); multiplies with the other poise bonus rates. 1: no change. Retail 1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Max Poise Bonus
Fields.Description: Cap on the extra poise damage the poise bonus rates can add to one hit. -1: no cap. Retail: 4 on most rows, 15 on 7.
Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: AI Body Radius Override
Fields.Description: When above 0, replaces the character's collision radius (m) in the radius its AI uses for its own body. −1: use the collision radius. Retail 1.5 on Draconic Tree Sentinel rows, 0.1 on a few Remembrance rows.

Fields.Name: Chaos Matching: Correction ID
Fields.Description: ChaosMatchingCorrectParam row with the character's Deep of Night scaling. Retail: 7700-7740 ("Small Threat" and similar threat tiers) on most enemies.

Fields.Name: Chaos Matching: SpEffect Set ID
Fields.Description: SpEffectSetParam row for the character when it is mutated in Deep of Night. Retail: 113000-113130 ("Set: Deep Night Mutation - VFX + Scaling"), -1 on 424 rows.

Fields.Name: Chaos Matching: Reward Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: Reward item lot (with the Dormant Power roll) used instead of the other reward lots when the character is mutated (Deep of Night), unless the spawn sets its own lot. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Chaos Matching: Enemy Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: Drop item lot used for the mutated character instead of its normal enemy item lot. When the character drops from a map item lot (Enemy Itemlot ID below 0, Map Itemlot ID set), Chaos Matching Item Lot ID - Map is used instead. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Chaos Matching Item Lot ID - Map
Fields.Description: Item lot used instead of Chaos Matching Item Lot ID when the character drops from a map item lot (Item Lot ID - Enemy below 0 and Item Lot ID - Map set) and its chaos-matching drop is active. −1: the normal item lot. Retail −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Analysis Distance Correction
Fields.Description: Metres subtracted from the distance to this character before Scholar's analysis distance graph is applied (never below 0), so larger characters count as closer. Retail: 0 on most rows; 0.1-17.5 on larger enemies.
